title: Add MiniMax-M3 (MSA: MiniMax Sparse Attention) support

target.summary: FFN layers in graph construction do not pass quantization scale tensors to build_ffn and build_moe_ffn, causing quantized weights (such as NVFP4 or MXFP8) to be evaluated unscaled and outputting garbled text.
notes: leading dense FFN call passes NULL instead of quantization scale tensors
routed experts MoE call does not forward scale tensors to build_moe_ffn
shared expert FFN call passes NULL instead of quantization scale tensors
definition of graph constructor containing the unscaled FFN calls
